lines.zh: 我贴着沙面飞，翅膀扫起一道灰。
lines.en: I fly low over the sand, wings sweeping up dust.

lines.zh: 走路对我太慢，我宁愿滑。
lines.en: Walking is too slow for me; I would rather glide.

lines.zh: 我离地两格，风托着我走。
lines.en: Two blocks up, the wind carries me along.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上跑得比我快。
lines.en: My shadow runs faster than I do on the sand.

lines.zh: 翅膀一压，我就往前窜一截。
lines.en: One beat of my wings and I lurch forward.

lines.zh: 沙暴里我反而飞得稳。
lines.en: In a sandstorm I actually fly steadier.

lines.zh: 我绕开沙柱，不碰它们。
lines.en: I veer around the sand columns and do not touch them.

lines.zh: 低飞的时候，能看清地上的骨头。
lines.en: Flying low, I can see the bones on the ground.

lines.zh: 我不用落地，落地会被埋。
lines.en: I do not land; landed, I would be buried.

lines.zh: 风往哪边，我就偏一点。
lines.en: Wherever the wind goes, I lean a little with it.

lines.zh: 这条路我从上面走过很多次。
lines.en: I have crossed this path many times from above.

lines.zh: 翅膀的声音先到，我到得晚些。
lines.en: The sound of my wings arrives first; I come after.

lines.zh: 我不落地，只靠一股气流挂着。
lines.en: I never touch the ground; one updraft holds me up.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我像挂着的破布。
lines.en: Holding still, I look like a hanging scrap of cloth.

lines.zh: 风把我推高一点，我又落回。
lines.en: Wind lifts me a little; I settle back.

lines.zh: 我在等地面上的东西动。
lines.en: I am waiting for something on the ground to move.

lines.zh: 翅膀酸了，可我不能停。
lines.en: My wings ache, but I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 我听见沙下的骨头在响。
lines.en: I hear bones shifting under the sand.

lines.zh: 这里太高，没人够得到我。
lines.en: This is high enough that nothing can reach me.

lines.zh: 我数着气流，一共三段。
lines.en: I count the air currents; there are three.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，靠风认路。
lines.en: I close my eyes and find my way by the wind.

lines.zh: 悬着比停着省力，很奇怪吧。
lines.en: Hovering costs less than resting; strange, is it not?

lines.zh: 从上面看你，你很矮。
lines.en: From up here you look very short.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的头顶，那里没有遮挡。
lines.en: I watch the top of your head; nothing covers it.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，光刺得你眯眼。
lines.en: You look up for me and the light makes you squint.

lines.zh: 我从上面看你的头顶。
lines.en: I look down at the top of your head.

lines.zh: 我在你上方绕了半圈。
lines.en: I have circled half a turn above you.

lines.zh: 你还没发现我在哪，很好。
lines.en: You have not found where I am; good.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀在动，你在握紧什么。
lines.en: Your shoulders move; you are gripping something.

lines.zh: 我从背后看你，看得最清楚。
lines.en: I see you best from behind.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁反光，很显眼。
lines.en: The iron on you catches light and gives you away.

lines.zh: 我盯了很久，你终于抬头了。
lines.en: I watched a long while; at last you looked up.

lines.zh: 你打中翅膀，我掉了一格。
lines.en: You hit my wing and I dropped a block.

lines.zh: 箭从下面来，我听见了风声。
lines.en: The arrow came from below; I heard its wind.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了一个口，飞起来偏。
lines.en: A tear in my wing makes me fly crooked.

lines.zh: 你打断我的翅骨，我在空中打转。
lines.en: You snapped a wing bone — I'm spinning in the air.

lines.zh: 我疼，但我在上面，你在下面。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am above and you are below.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的爪，抓不住了。
lines.en: You cut my claw, and my grip is gone.

lines.zh: 我掉了几根羽毛，还会长。
lines.en: A few feathers fell; they will grow back.

lines.zh: 一百二十九颗心，没这么快完。
lines.en: A hundred and twenty-nine hearts do not end so fast.

lines.zh: 你别得意，我还能升起来。
lines.en: Do not gloat; I can still climb.

lines.zh: 沙进了伤口，磨得厉害。
lines.en: Sand got in the wound and grinds badly.

lines.zh: 你在下面举东西，我只看见影子。
lines.en: You raise something below; I only see a shadow.

lines.zh: 吃的留给你自己，我俯冲更快。
lines.en: Keep the food; my dive is quicker.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是你手里的温度。
lines.en: What I smell is the warmth in your hands.

lines.zh: 别拿食物换我不咬你。
lines.en: Do not trade food for my mercy.

lines.zh: 我从高处看，食物小得像沙。
lines.en: From above, food looks as small as a grain.

lines.zh: 你放下东西，手就空了。
lines.en: Set it down and your hands are empty.

lines.zh: 我不落地，吃得着才怪。
lines.en: I do not land; how would I eat it?

lines.zh: 你的好意，我当成诱饵。
lines.en: I take your kindness for bait.

lines.zh: 举高一点，我看看是什么。
lines.en: Raise it higher; let me see what it is.

lines.zh: 我对地面上的东西没兴趣。
lines.en: I have no interest in things on the ground.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的时候，带着风。
lines.en: When I hit you, the wind comes with me.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫到你的脸，很疼吧。
lines.en: My wing caught your face; that stings.

lines.zh: 我在空中撞你，你就仰倒。
lines.en: I strike you in the air and you fall backward.

lines.zh: 碰一下我就弹开，再回来。
lines.en: One touch and I bounce off, then return.

lines.zh: 你跳起来够我，差半格。
lines.en: You jump for me and miss by half a block.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀骨很硬，别硬碰。
lines.en: My wing bones are hard; do not meet them.

lines.zh: 撞歪了我，我得转两圈才稳。
lines.en: Knocked aside, I need two turns to steady.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，沙在我翅上留下痕。
lines.en: We brushed; sand left a mark on my wing.

lines.zh: 你把我顶到沙柱上，我记住了。
lines.en: You shoved me into a sand column, and I remember.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就抓着你上去。
lines.en: One more collision and I will carry you up.

lines.zh: 天上只有我一个在飞。
lines.en: I am the only one flying up here.

lines.zh: 配对要在高处，可这里没有高处。
lines.en: Pairing belongs high up, and there is no high place.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，会先绕三圈。
lines.en: When my kind meet, they circle three times first.

lines.zh: 我没有巢，我睡在风里。
lines.en: I keep no nest; I sleep in the wind.

lines.zh: 两个翅膀撞一起，只会掉沙。
lines.en: Two pairs of wings meeting only shake down sand.

lines.zh: 这片天太空，回声都没有。
lines.en: This sky is too empty even for echoes.

lines.zh: 我很久没听见同类叫了。
lines.en: I have not heard my kind call in a long while.

lines.zh: 成双的东西，在这里活得短。
lines.en: Paired things do not last long here.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是打算陪我飞吗。
lines.en: You ask that as if you would fly with me.

lines.zh: 我的影子是我唯一的伴。
lines.en: My shadow is my only company.

lines.zh: 我从沙里抓起一块东西，飞高了。
lines.en: I snatch something from the sand and climb.

lines.zh: 爪子夹不住太圆的石头。
lines.en: My claws cannot grip a stone this round.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看看，不合意就丢。
lines.en: I pick it up to look, and drop it if I dislike it.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，我懒得追。
lines.en: I will not bother chasing what falls.

lines.zh: 骨头很轻，我带着飞了一段。
lines.en: A bone is light; I carried it a while.

lines.zh: 我把铁片丢在你脚边，算还你。
lines.en: I drop the iron at your feet, as if returning it.

lines.zh: 带太多东西，我飞不动。
lines.en: Carrying too much, I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 我捡的东西都掉在半路。
lines.en: Everything I pick up falls along the way.

lines.zh: 亮的东西在下面，我看见了。
lines.en: Something bright is below; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 这件归我，别伸手。
lines.en: This one is mine; do not reach.

lines.zh: 你走进沙地中间，那就好办了。
lines.en: You walked into the open sand; that makes it easy.

lines.zh: 我从上面看见你了，很显眼。
lines.en: I spotted you from above; you stand out.

lines.zh: 一百二十九颗心的身子，撞得起。
lines.en: A body of a hundred and twenty-nine hearts can take a hit.

lines.zh: 我一击十一点，不算轻。
lines.en: Eleven points a blow is not light.

lines.zh: 翅膀已经压下去了，你听见了吗。
lines.en: My wings have already tilted; did you hear?

lines.zh: 你喜欢站着，我正好俯冲。
lines.en: You like standing still; that suits my dive.

lines.zh: 这地方没有屋顶，你无处可躲。
lines.en: No roof here, so there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，再决定从哪来。
lines.en: I circle once before choosing my angle.

lines.zh: 你不抬头，我就更省事。
lines.en: If you do not look up, it is easier for me.

lines.zh: 风帮我加速，你帮不了自己。
lines.en: The wind speeds me; nothing speeds you.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀的那一下，就是俯冲开始。
lines.en: The moment I fold my wings, the dive has begun.

lines.zh: 沙子会先落下，然后是我。
lines.en: The sand falls first, and then I do.

lines.zh: 你手里的弓，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the bow in your hands.

lines.zh: 站那儿别动，省得我找。
lines.en: Stay right there; save me the search.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在异位的沙上很响。
lines.en: Your steps are loud on the Elsewhere sand.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀，那是要下来。
lines.en: I fold my wings. That means I am coming down.

lines.zh: 我压低高度，你就跑不掉了。
lines.en: I drop lower, and then you cannot escape.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，我提前到了左边。
lines.en: You run left; I am already left of you.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕第三圈，翅膀挡住光。
lines.en: Third circle above you — my wings are blocking the light.

lines.zh: 还有五格，我数得清。
lines.en: Five blocks left, and I count them clearly.

lines.zh: 你在沙里跑不快，我知道。
lines.en: You cannot run fast in sand; I know it.

lines.zh: 翅膀的声音忽远忽近，对吧。
lines.en: The wingbeat sounds near, then far, does it not?

lines.zh: 你躲到岩石下，我可以等你。
lines.en: Hide under the rock; I can wait.

lines.zh: 我不急，我比你有的是时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I have more time than you.

lines.zh: 你回头找我的时候，我就在头顶。
lines.en: When you turn to find me, I am overhead.

lines.zh: 这一圈绕完，我就下来。
lines.en: When this circle closes, I come down.

lines.zh: 你越跑越偏，方向错了。
lines.en: You are drifting; your direction is wrong.

lines.zh: 地面上的东西，最后都会停。
lines.en: Things on the ground always stop at last.

lines.zh: 我把你赶到空地上。
lines.en: I am driving you into the open.

lines.zh: 最后一段，我不再绕了。
lines.en: This last stretch, I stop circling.

lines.zh: 我在你上方画了个圈。
lines.en: I trace a circle above you.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我的时候，太晚了。
lines.en: By the time you look up, it is too late.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀刚好挡住光。
lines.en: My wings are just the right size to block the light.

lines.zh: 你跑的方向，我早就飞过。
lines.en: I have already flown the way you are running.

lines.zh: 这个高度，你的箭够不着。
lines.en: At this height your arrows cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我不用落地，也能杀你。
lines.en: I do not need to land to kill you.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下，这就是我的打法。
lines.en: I come down from above; that is how I fight.

lines.zh: 俯冲的时候，风先撞到你。
lines.en: In the dive, the wind hits you first.

lines.zh: 这一撞带着全身的重量。
lines.en: That impact carried all of my weight.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，你的袖子破了。
lines.en: I clawed once and your sleeve tore.

lines.zh: 十一点不重，但我会补第二下。
lines.en: Eleven is not heavy, but I follow with a second.

lines.zh: 你举盾晚了半拍。
lines.en: You raised your shield half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我打完就升起来，你打不着。
lines.en: I rise after striking; you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 你的头顶没有盔甲，我记得。
lines.en: Your head has no helmet; I remember.

lines.zh: 这一下让你后退，很好。
lines.en: That pushed you back; good.

lines.zh: 我不停在一处，你砍空了。
lines.en: I never stay in one spot; your swing missed.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇在你脸上，也算一击。
lines.en: My wing across your face counts as a hit.

lines.zh: 你的血味让我的俯冲更准。
lines.en: The smell of your blood sharpens my dive.

lines.zh: 我要的是你的肩膀，不是命。
lines.en: I am after your shoulder, not your life.

lines.zh: 下一次我从另一边来。
lines.en: Next time I come from the other side.

lines.zh: 我从背后抓你，你听不见。
lines.en: I claw you from behind. You never hear it.

lines.zh: 这一击带着我俯冲的势。
lines.en: This blow carries my whole dive.

lines.zh: 我的爪划过你的肩甲。
lines.en: My talons rake across your pauldron.

lines.zh: 你抬头，正好接住这一下。
lines.en: You look up just in time to catch this.

lines.zh: 打中之后我立刻升高。
lines.en: I climb away the instant I connect.

lines.zh: 我杀你不为掉落，只是顺手。
lines.en: I do not kill you for loot. It is just convenient.

lines.zh: 沙里翻起一阵风，我就出来了。
lines.en: A gust turned over the sand, and out I came.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘顶上被抛起来。
lines.en: I was flung up from the crest of the dune.

lines.zh: 第一次扇翅膀，沙落了一地。
lines.en: My first wingbeat brought sand down everywhere.

lines.zh: 异位的上空又多了一个影子。
lines.en: Another shadow joins the sky over Dustopia.

lines.zh: 我出生就在空中，没落过地。
lines.en: I was born in the air and never landed.

lines.zh: 地面上的东西开始动了。
lines.en: Things on the ground have started to move.

lines.zh: 风把我托稳，我才睁眼。
lines.en: The wind steadied me before I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在高处看了一圈，全是沙。
lines.en: I looked around from above; it is all sand.

lines.zh: 一百二十九颗心，够飞很久。
lines.en: A hundred and twenty-nine hearts will fly a long while.

lines.zh: 我从灰里来，翅膀还在抖。
lines.en: I come out of the grey, wings still trembling.

lines.zh: 这片天没人管，我来管。
lines.en: No one watches this sky; I will.

lines.zh: 别抬头，我先看看你。
lines.en: Do not look up; let me look at you first.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的翅膀就卷起来。
lines.en: Fire curls my wings up.

lines.zh: 摔在沙上，我弹了两下才停。
lines.en: I hit the sand and bounced twice before stopping.

lines.zh: 水沾上翅膀，我就飞不动了。
lines.en: Water on my wings and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我抛得老高，又摔下来。
lines.en: The blast threw me high and then dropped me.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翅膀，留了个洞。
lines.en: The arrow punched a hole through my wing.

lines.zh: 药水雾一罩，我的翅膀发沉。
lines.en: Potion mist covers me and my wings grow heavy.

lines.zh: 飞太久没吃东西，我发晕。
lines.en: Flying so long without food makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 雷打在翅膀上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck my wing and numbed me all over.

lines.zh: 下面没有地面，我不敢往下看。
lines.en: There is no ground below, and I dare not look.
